onset_evidence: Instruction: in the black lotus the satguru dwells; know the til-sized point there; fix the mind there moment by moment so that not one blink breaks it (छिन छिन मन के तहाँ लगावे। एक पलक दुटन नहिं पावे), dwell in the til window night and day; then the star appears and the anahad sound is heard. Prerequisite: refuge at the satguru's feet (सतगरू पद). No time scale beyond 'night and day' and 'some days' (कछु दिवस) of travel within.

stages.label: तिल / इक तारा
stages.description: Surat fixed at the til; a single star appears at the sky-door; anahad nad heard

stages.label: बीज (lightning)
stages.description: Lightning flashes in the sky; light grows as surat moves toward the door

stages.label: पाँच रंग
stages.description: White and black, then five colours: black, red, white, yellow, green

stages.label: जोति
stages.description: Tej and jyoti shown, like a lamp seen through a temple door

stages.label: चंद
stages.description: The jyoti bursts; a full moon seen within, moonlight spreads; many stars

stages.label: भान (sun)
stages.description: Star and moon fade; light like the midday sun in the ghat; the seven continents, oceans, rivers and all beings seen within

what_to_do_with_light: Keep the surat steady (ठहराइ) and keep ascending; the lights mark successive stations, not the goal.
obstacles_and_fixes: The mind must not break away even for a blink
interpretation: The lights are the stations of the surat's ascent through the inner sky (gagan) toward the satguru's abode.
practice_summary: Taking refuge in the satguru, fix the attention (surat) at the sesame-seed point in the dark lotus behind the eyes, renewing it moment by moment so that not even a blink breaks it, and live there night and day. A single star appears at the door of the sky and the unstruck sound is heard; listen and let the surat settle. Lightning flashes; the light grows as the surat advances. White and black appear, then five colours. Then a light like a lamp seen through a temple door; it bursts and a full moon appears within, then many stars; then a light like the midday sun fills the body, in which the whole cosmos is seen.

key_passages.anchor: छिन छिन मन के तहाँ लगावे। एक पलक दुटन नहिं पावे ॥
key_passages.paraphrase: Fix the mind on the til-sized point moment by moment, not breaking for a single blink; dwell in the til window night and day.
key_passages.quote: स्थाम कंज लोला गिरि साई ।तिल परिमान जान जन का हुं॥ छिन छिन मन के तहाँ लगावे। एक पलक दुटन नहिं पावे ॥

key_passages.paraphrase: At the sky-door a single star appears; the unstruck sound is heard.

key_passages.anchor: जस जस सुरति सरकि सत द्वारा।ततस तस बढ़त जात उंजिया रा ॥
